measure_name: Climate-informed policy, regulation and sector standards
definition: Formal policies, regulations, codes, standards or institutional procedures that explicitly incorporate climate resilience, adaptation or emissions reduction into future investment or operations. The instrument must apply beyond the assets financed by this project. Includes development or revision of such instruments; completed adoption is not required to identify the intervention. Project-specific technical requirements belong to the relevant technical measure. Excludes generic institutional strengthening, climate aspirations and strategies cited only as context.
